title: Nell Waits Out the Wet
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 2 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds zz, qu, ch
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 32-sound stage (zz, qu, ch just added).

pages.text: Nell can buzz. Nell can buzz a lot.
pages.illustration: Nell the yellow and black bee flying low over a wooden bird table in a garden.

pages.text: It is wet. It is not fun.
pages.illustration: Rain beginning to fall over the bird table, Nell looking unhappy in the open.

pages.text: Nell is quick. Nell zips into a box.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee darting fast into a small wooden box fixed under the bird table roof.
Nell the bee sitting still inside the small wooden box, dry, rain falling outside.
Nell the bee sitting beside a small brown beetle inside the box, facing each other.

pages.text: Nell and the bug sit. Nell and the bug nap.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and the small beetle both settled down quietly inside the box, eyes closed.

pages.text: It is not wet. The sun is up.
pages.illustration: Bright sunshine over the bird table now, raindrops still on the roof but the rain stopped.

pages.text: Nell can buzz. Nell had fun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying happily out of the box and up above the bird table into the sun.
